alert_case_resolved_complete.name: alert_case_resolved_complete
alert_case_resolved_complete.value: "alert_case"."follow_up" <> 'resolved' OR ("alert_case"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "alert_case"."resolution_outcome" IS NOT NULL)

instrument_version_published_complete.name: instrument_version_published_complete
instrument_version_published_complete.value: "instrument_version"."status" = 'draft' OR ("instrument_version"."definition_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument_version"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

legacy_case_handoff_open_only.name: legacy_case_handoff_open_only
legacy_case_handoff_open_only.value: "legacy_case"."handed_off_at" IS NULL OR ("legacy_case"."legacy_status" = 'open' AND "legacy_case"."handed_off_by" IS NOT NULL AND "legacy_case"."handoff_note" IS NOT NULL)

legacy_case_resolved_after_handoff.name: legacy_case_resolved_after_handoff
legacy_case_resolved_after_handoff.value: "legacy_case"."resolved_at" IS NULL OR ("legacy_case"."handed_off_at" IS NOT NULL AND "legacy_case"."resolution_outcome" IS NOT NULL)

operator_item_review_complete.name: operator_item_review_complete
operator_item_review_complete.value: "operator_item"."reviewed_at" IS NULL OR ("operator_item"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_item"."review_note" IS NOT NULL)

shop_survey_settings_outreach_ready.name: shop_survey_settings_outreach_ready
shop_survey_settings_outreach_ready.value: "shop_survey_settings"."mode" = 'test' OR ("shop_survey_settings"."delivery_cutoff" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_survey_settings"."instrument_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_survey_settings"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

suppression_action_ack_complete.name: suppression_action_ack_complete
suppression_action_ack_complete.value: "suppression_action"."status" = 'outstanding' OR ("suppression_action"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "suppression_action"."result" IS NOT NULL)

survey_response_submitted_complete.name: survey_response_submitted_complete
survey_response_submitted_complete.value: "survey_response"."status" = 'draft' OR ("survey_response"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_response"."submit_payload_hash" IS NOT NULL)
